tracked_todos.name: Architecture contract, split into five packages
tracked_todos.goal: Produce the machine-readable contract an agent generates from, so no file is ever created by inference.

tracked_todos.name: Supabase Lite migration
tracked_todos.goal: The Lite schema exists on a fresh project, so the frontend has real tables to build against.

tracked_todos.name: RLS access proof
tracked_todos.goal: Prove the access model in code, because DB-1 makes RLS the authorization layer rather than a safety net.

tracked_todos.name: Types and seed
tracked_todos.goal: The frontend can import generated types and log into a populated workspace.

tracked_todos.name: Conform the frontend scaffold
tracked_todos.goal: The existing scaffold obeys the folder law, so no later task has to retrofit it.

tracked_todos.name: Entities kernel
tracked_todos.goal: A local database that is the app's only read surface, so every later feature is offline-capable by construction.

tracked_todos.name: Design system
tracked_todos.goal: Atoms, theme and the provider tree exist, so every later component composes rather than invents.

tracked_todos.name: Auth and workspace shell
tracked_todos.goal: A user signs in and opens a workspace with a leader, a persona and a goal.

tracked_todos.name: Sync kernel
tracked_todos.goal: Local writes reach Supabase and remote changes reach Dexie, so the app is correct online and offline before any feature depends on it.

tracked_todos.name: PDF canvas
tracked_todos.goal: The workspace PDF renders, pans and zooms smoothly on a tablet.

tracked_todos.name: Text highlight
tracked_todos.goal: Selecting text on the PDF creates a persisted, exact-text focus point.

tracked_todos.name: Notes and handwriting
tracked_todos.goal: A focus point can carry a note, typed or handwritten, and handwriting produces text with no model and no network.

tracked_todos.name: Region highlight and OCR
tracked_todos.goal: Pages with no text layer can still be marked, with confidence-gated OCR text.

tracked_todos.name: Offline and export
tracked_todos.goal: The private sheet works with the network off, and a workspace can leave as a portable bundle.

tracked_todos.name: Command endpoints
tracked_todos.goal: The four server endpoints exist with real auth and no business logic in the route layer.

tracked_todos.name: Leader import
tracked_todos.goal: A leader drops in an already-highlighted PDF and every mark becomes a group focus point with a note and a slug.

tracked_todos.name: Realtime presence
tracked_todos.goal: A workspace feels shared: you see who is there and marks appear as they are made.

tracked_todos.name: Wire the document view
tracked_todos.goal: The workspace document view is mounted, so built highlight and capture surfaces are user-visible.

tracked_todos.name: Workspace context and the note panel
tracked_todos.goal: A shared workspace context hands profileId/sessionId to any feature, and the note panel mounts the note sheet.

tracked_todos.name: Export the workspace bundle
tracked_todos.goal: A member exports the open workspace from the shell as the portable bundle.
